title: GETMAIN SET(ptr) FLENGTH INITIMG, SET ADDRESS OF, pointer arithmetic through a binary REDEFINES, ADDRESS OF a subordinate item and FREEMAIN; a length below 1 raises LENGERR RESP2 1 and zeroes the pointer

scenarios.summary: CAGMPT GETMAINs 16 bytes with INITIMG 'Z', views them with SET ADDRESS OF, writes HEAD + 12 bytes, reaches the 12 bytes by adding 4 to the pointer and by ADDRESS OF the subordinate item, writes through that view, then FREEMAINs
CAGMZ issues GETMAIN with FLENGTH 0, FLENGTH -1 and LENGTH 0 (LENGERR RESP2 1 each, pointer zero), then a valid GETMAIN and FREEMAIN
